This week, I toured the Tractor Supply Distribution Center in Waverly. This center employs over 300 Nebraskans and is over 600,000 square feet. 

We discussed wins from the Working Families Tax Cuts, including the 100% bonus depreciation provision. This allows Tractor Supply to invest in Nebraska and other stores across the county.

I also had the opportunity to meet with some of their teammates, including Michael, who celebrated his birthday yesterday!

Yesterday, I joined @TeamPillen and @NebraskaDOT to highlight the Capital City Connector Lincoln Interstate Bridges Project.  This project will modernize our state’s infrastructure and improve roadway safety for Nebraskans.  I was glad to support this project and help secure federal funding to make it possible.
 
Together, we are making the Good Life better for all Nebraskans.

Terrible scenes coming out of Venezuela. Our prayers are with the people of Venezuela in the aftermath of these devastating earthquakes.

America stands ready to help. @SecRubio has already deployed teams to assist and support in Venezuela.


Fox News (@FoxNews)

Over a hundred people are dead after two powerful earthquakes devastated Venezuela, with officials warning the death toll is expected to rise.

Dramatic video shows a home collapsing in El Junquito as terrified residents run for cover.
